title: finishTrackerOccurrence
responsibility: Record the done or failed result of one occurrence of a recurring Tracker item and reopen it for the next.

inputs.name: finishTrackerOccurrence.item
inputs.description: The recurring item, with its cadence, time zone, current status and latest due occurrence.

inputs.name: finishTrackerOccurrence.body
inputs.description: The done request: an optional occurrence time, failed flag, note and actor.

inputs.name: finishTrackerOccurrence.context
inputs.description: The mutation clock and the node recorded as the actor when the request names none.

inputs.name: nextTrackerReminder.every
inputs.description: Cron schedule or macro the reminder repeats on.

inputs.name: nextTrackerReminder.timeZone
inputs.description: Time zone the schedule is read in; Europe/Lisbon when absent.

inputs.name: nextTrackerReminder.after
inputs.description: Epoch milliseconds the returned time must be later than.

inputs.name: finishTrackerReminder.item
inputs.description: The repeating reminder being marked done, with its armed time and schedule.

inputs.name: finishTrackerReminder.body
inputs.description: Done request; an occurrence names the armed time shown, a note is kept, failed is refused.

inputs.name: finishTrackerReminder.context
inputs.description: Mutation context supplying the current time.

outputs.name: finishTrackerOccurrence
outputs.description: The recorded result and appended note; a done or in-progress item is reopened. It refuses a bad time or no due occurrence.
